target.description: Prefer preserving the bishop on the b-file.

pending.message: I recommend Bb7 largely to preserve the bishop instead of accepting White's simplifying exchange. From here, the bishop continues defending a6 while the king protects c5. Bxg4 looks legal, but hxg4 or Nxg4 would remove Black's last minor piece. The choice depends largely on avoiding further concessions, not on any realistic claim of equality. In practice, Kc7 would allow Bxc8 Kxc8, while unsupported pawn advances leave the bishop hanging. Bb7 seems the most practical retreat while White retains a decisive material advantage.
